new_commodity_proposals.evidence: The vocabulary already names 93/7 Ground Beef [93-7-ground-beef], but the table's board check says no commodity claims it while today's captures carry matching packages. It is not a spelling variant of ground-beef-8020: 93/7 is a separate case-ready SKU at a higher price per lb and a different gram-for-gram macro (24 g protein per 4 oz vs 17.2 g per 100 g), and the only beef grinds the estate is known to price are ground-beef-8020 and beef-stew-meat. If a lean-grind id already exists under another spelling, treat this as an alias onto it.
